c6af7a3a9706.title: Corporate IT Intern
c6af7a3a9706.description_html:
What you do
Providing day-to-day support for end user requests related to desktop software/hardware, telecom, and video conferencing
Troubleshoot of equipment
Preparation of new user desktops and laptop devices
Handling maintenance of hardware and software



What you offer
Ability to identify, research, and resolve technical problems
Present a professional demeanor and be comfortable working with people from all levels of the organization
Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills
